note: The heap object length is read from attacker-controlled shared-message metadata and becomes the requested decode size.
The requested size is propagated into the wrapped-buffer allocator, which returns a buffer sized for mesg_size.
The heap payload is copied into the buffer before decoding, preserving the attacker-controlled length and contents.
The decoder consumes mesg_ptr with mesg_size bytes; if mesg_size is inconsistent with the actual serialized message, downstream parsing can read past the heap buffer.
